layout: Single step screen. Light bg (#F8FAFC). Clean, professional feel. Consistent layout with other wizard steps (same top bar, progress, content area, CTA positioning).

layout_structure.top_bar: Back arrow (top-left, DISABLED/lighter for step 1). No skip link.
layout_structure.progress: Step indicator centered: 4 dot circles. Step 1: ORANGE (#FF8A34) filled. Steps 2-4: gray (#E2E8F0) outlined.
layout_structure.illustration: Large user/profile icon centered, ~80px, in blue (#003F8C)
layout_structure.heading: 'Personal Info' — navy (#0B1B3B), h2 (24px), bold, centered
layout_structure.subtitle: 'Isi data diri kamu untuk memulai' — slate (#64748B), body (16px), centered
layout_structure.cta: Button 'Lanjut' — orange (#FF8A34), full width, 14px/24px padding, 12px radius. DISABLED until all required fields valid.
layout_structure.spacing: 24px between sections. 16px horizontal padding mobile, 32px desktop.

elements: TOP BAR: Back arrow (ghost, disabled — lighter gray #CBD5E1) left. No skip link.
PROGRESS: 4 horizontal dots. Dot 1: orange (#FF8A34) filled. Dots 2-4: gray (#E2E8F0) outlined.
SUBTITLE: 'Isi data diri kamu untuk memulai' centered, slate #64748B, 16px.
PHOTO UPLOAD: Circular avatar area (100px diameter). Dashed border #E2E8F0, camera icon center (#94A3B8). Tap → upload + crop. Preview replaces placeholder.
FULL NAME: Text input, label 'Nama Lengkap', placeholder 'Masukkan nama lengkap'
PHONE: Input with country code dropdown (+62 default), placeholder '81234567890'
PASSWORD: Input with show/hide toggle, strength indicator below
CONFIRM PASSWORD: Input, validation match check
CTA: 'Lanjut' — orange (#FF8A34), full width. Disabled: gray #CBD5E1.
notes: IDENTICAL LAYOUT to steps 2-4 — only content area changes. All required fields must be valid before CTA enables. Photo upload shows preview after selection.
